author: SinOfStrife
name: PKLens
short: Silently check PluralKit profiles & fronters with 1-click menus. Works server-wide and as a personal User App!
description: A lightweight, privacy-focused PluralKit inspector for Discord. View public system profiles and current fronters without chat spam—all lookups are private and ephemeral. Works server-wide for everyone when added to a server, or as an account-level User App to inspect systems anywhere across DMs, group chats, and external servers!
install_msg: Thanks for installing PKLens! Use slash commands (`/pkfronters`, `/pkprofile`) or right-click any user profile (`Apps` ➔ `fronters` or `profile`) to view system info silently. Works server-wide, or install it to your personal profile to use across Discord!
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store data. Looking up a user sends their Discord user ID to the PluralKit API at api.pluralkit.me.
